booking.howItWorks: Book online or fill out the party form with dates, guest count and requests; the party coordinator reaches out to confirm. A non-refundable deposit secures the date. Don't pay a deposit until you get a confirmation email.

faq.q: Is a deposit required for parties?
faq.a: A non-refundable deposit is required to secure the party date. Please do not submit a deposit until you receive a confirmation email.

We can accommodate a wide variety of group events such as field trips, church events, birthday parties, company team bonding, sports team party, fundraising and more. Contact Brooke using the group events form.

faq.q: Are there height requirements for the Splash Zone?
faq.a: Must be 5 years old and 36" tall to play. For the Splash Zone party, each child must be 42" tall to participate, no exceptions.
Closed for the season. Join us next May to beat the summer heat with our giant inflatable water slides and bounce house!

faq.q: Who can drive the Supercharged go-karts?
faq.a: Must have a driver's license to participate. Single passenger only.

faq.q: Can a child ride with a parent?
faq.a: Parent and child in a two-seater Power Up kart, and child passengers on Spin Zone with a parent, are allowed for children age 3 and up.

faq.q: Are you open in bad weather?
faq.a: During our slow season, we are weather and foot traffic permitted. Call us or check our Facebook page for real time updates.
